examples.text: THE DOOR AJAR LIGHT WAS CONTINUING TO TURN ON, EVEN WHILE DRIVING, CREATING AN UNSAFE DRIVING SITUATION AS ALL THE INTERIOR LIGHTS COME ON AND WILL NOT TURN OFF UNTIL YOU PULL OVER, PUT THE CAR IN PARK, OPEN THE DOOR, PUSH IN THE DOOR LATCH, AND THEN SHUT IT AGAIN AND AGAIN UNTIL THE DOOR AJAR COMES OFF. Tailgate randomly opened while in park. This is a problem for multiple reasons. When hauling a travel trailer when you put the truck in park the tailgate falls into the jack denting the tailgate and scratching the paint. On some trailers it would be possible for the tailgate to fall onto the jack switches causing the jack to go down unexpectedly. The only way to get the trailer off is not put the truck in Park which isn’t safe at all! The truck rolls in neutral if the parking brake isn’t on. You should be able to put the truck in park and not worry about the tailgate. I called GM a few months

THE DRIVER'S SIDE SLIDING DOOR ON OUR 2016 DODGE CARAVAN CANNOT BE OPENED. IT STOPPED WORKING AFTER HAVING THE VEHICLE FOR LESS THAN TWO YEARS. IT CANNOT BE OPENED FROM THE INSIDE OR OUTSIDE WHICH IS A SAFETY CONCERN FOR PASSENGERS TRYING TO GET OUT OF THE VEHICLE QUICKLY IN AN EMERGENCY. WE WERE TOLD THE INTERIOR LATCH WAS BROKEN AND THAT IT WOULD BE EXPENSIVE TO FIX. I BELIEVE THIS IS A KNOWN ISSUE WITH THESE VEHICLES AS A NUMBER OF OTHERS HAVE REPORTED THE SAME PROBLEM.

THE BACK RIGHT PASSENGER WINDOW REGULATOR BROKE AND THE WINDOW FELL DOWN INTO THE DOOR. IT HAS BEEN TAPED FOR A WHILE BECAUSE IT IS ASTRONOMICALLY EXPENSIVE TO FIX. I SEE MANY JEEPS DRIVING AROUND ALL THE TIME WITH TAPE ON THE WINDOWS BECAUSE OF THIS EXACT ISSUE. AFTER GOOGLING THE ISSUE IT IS WELL KNOWN IN THE JEEP COMMUNITY.

CONNECT THE PHONE TO STEREO, ACTIVATE DEVICE ASSISTANT, PHONE CALL OR PLAY AUDIO FROM THE DEVICE THROUGH STEREO. THE STEREO WILL REBOOT. THIS HAS OCCURRED A NUMBER OF TIMES DURING THE FIRST COUPLE WEEKS OF OWNERSHIP. DOESN'T MATTER IF VEHICLE IS IN MOTION OR NOT.

The locking mechanism inside the driver’s side door was not always working…it would sometimes lock and Not Unlock and other times just Not Lock. We could sometimes hear the mechanism trying to work, but not. Seemed to happen more on cold weather days. My husband has had to “crawl out” of the passenger side door when he could not get the lock to unlock, nor able to pull it up. He’s a big man. This is certainly a safety issue.
